crew.overview: Loving but irresponsible dad Daniel Hillard, estranged from his exasperated spouse, is crushed by a court order allowing only weekly visits with his kids. When Daniel learns his ex needs a housekeeper, he gets the job -- disguised as a British nanny. Soon he becomes not only his children's best pal but the kind of parent he should have been from the start.
crew.title: Mrs. Doubtfire

crew.overview: A Russian and a German sniper play a game of cat-and-mouse during the Battle of Stalingrad in WWII.
crew.title: Enemy at the Gates

details.biography: Jay Roberts was a payroll accountant for films and still photographer for shorts. He was known for Cocoon (1985), Enemy Mine (1985), Aliens (1986), Mrs. Doubtfire (1993), Metro (1997), I Dreamed of Africa (2000), Enemy at the Gates (2001), The Bourne Identity (2002), King Kong (2005), The Bourne Ultimatum (2007), and Public Enemies (2009), among others. He died on October 17, 2020 in Redondo Beach, California, USA.
details.name: Jay Roberts
